source.source_text: Purpose: report Edge, Local Broker and optional helper health/version/reachability without secret material. Input: include_components?:boolean. Output: component states, versions, degraded reasons. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.control.read; target broker; timeout 3000ms; cap 64KiB; network none; filesystem none; secrets redacted; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 1 planned. Must not return tokens, sockets with credentials or auth configuration values.
